scene.primary_note: scene-free parcel: no scene can take the skybox clock over, so the client's world clock applies on both builds
scene.sky_policy: Dynamic Skybox ON, so the sun is (utc_unix * 12) mod 86400 seconds of in-game time; both arms launch inside the same 2 s phase, period 7200 s
scene.sky_policy_why_not_off: with Dynamic Skybox off, 2.x reads skybox_time with try_to::<f64>() on an Int variant, fails, and falls back to 0.0 = midnight (lib/crates/dcl_engine/src/sky/skybox_time.rs)
